transcription: Am I cheater? I was in a relationship for three years with someone. Let's call him Z. Our relationship has been long distance since day one. We've hardly spent time together in person, which has been one of the biggest reasons behind most of our fights. Another major issue was our gotra, which happened to be the same. Z is mature, calm, and like a green forest he handles everything on his own and never demands anything. He loves me deeply, and I love him too. That's the only thing I've always been sure about over the last three years. Our relationship had its ups and downs, like most do. Recently, I shifted to Mumbai with my family for my father's job. In our building, there was a boy let's call him P. My friend A, who came along for a month-long internship, and I decided to ask P his name, and we did. For some reason, I just wanted to talk to him more and learn about his university. I managed to find his Instagram ID, and that entire night we just talked. I felt something different while talking to him. Soon, we became close. We would chat all day, meet at home to play Uno, on the terrace, or in the society park. We often shared intense eye contact that felt unusual to me. One day we went to Marine Drive with others, and he told me, Tom Ash sooned our lag rahi tea. He sat beside me, looked at me, and said, you are perfect. I started to feel like he was giving me hints, despite knowing I was in a relationship. I felt guilty because I was serious about Z, and growing close to someone else was eating me up mentally. I thought P felt something too because his eyes and actions showed it. I was stressed for over a week. I told Z everything I didn't lie about anything. But the guilt didn't go away. I met P again on the terrace. One day he half-hugged me, held my hand, and we walked in the light rain under a yellow street light. It was beautiful, but I told him I was doing wrong with Z and walked away. I was completely confused P was giving me the time, presence, and P's I had never received from Z, which is probably why I got close to him. Still, I kept talking to P and decided to stay with him, which was the worst decision ever. I don't know if I was confused or under some black magic. One day P, A, and I planned to sneak out for drinks. They had Vodka, I had Maza. While planning on the terrace, he suddenly said, let's stop here. I don't want to go forward. I was shocked I had imagined a future with him. I held his hands, looked into his eyes, and confessed my feelings and he said, I make everyone feel special. That doesn't mean you are. I was shattered. He took back everything he'd shown or said. I told him I liked him, and he said he liked me too, but had no real feelings. And no, it wasn't because of my existing relationship I later found out he was dating a few more girls. I was just his neighbor, someone to pass time with. His fake promises and actions broke me. I told Z everything every single thing. He was heartbroken because of what I did. He took his time, and I respected that, because I honestly didn't deserve forgiveness. I believed I was a cheater. But Z, being the green flag that he is, accepted me with all my flaws and mistakes. He said I told him the truth, accepted everything, and everyone deserves a second chance.
